fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled truck entrance via a divided driveway running south off E Raines Rd at a signalized intersection. z19-z20 satellite shows the in/out divided lanes, perimeter chain-link fence meeting the entrance on both sides, and a guard booth in the median - vehicles visibly queued at the checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed at z20: a small ~1-vehicle-footprint structure sits in the median island of the divided entrance lane, with a stopped vehicle beside it and the perimeter fence terminating at it. Classic staffed guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved apron between the gate and the building/dock area; the entrance opens onto a large internal yard with ample holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long divided approach from Raines Rd to the building plus a large internal apron - easily holds 3+ trucks queued.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entrance apron with significant unused paved width beside the in/out lanes - room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single entrance point on E Raines Rd handles both in and out via the divided driveway.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1 inbound lane from the divided-driveway striping; satellite resolution limits exact count - low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long bank of dock doors on the east face of the main building with many Frito-Lay trailers backed in; additional dock doors on the south/SW face. Total estimated ~55 across faces - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked trailer-parking rows on the east side (hundreds of trailers in long rows) plus additional drop space - well over 50 trailer stalls. Note: the easternmost lot (5261 E Raines Rd) is a separate Container Transload & Export operation; the on-property Frito-Lay drop yard alone still exceeds 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces (east face and south/SW face) indicating separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Memphis metro southeast industrial corridor, surrounded by large warehouses and distribution centers.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single large connected plant building mass; the adjacent transload yard to the east is a separate company, so not a Frito-Lay campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identifiable in the truck path - low confidence, possible but not confirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: A major rail yard and curving rail line run along the SW of the broader industrial park, but no spur clearly penetrates the Frito-Lay property; marked false with low confidence.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box yields ~78 acres for the plant building, dock aprons, and on-property drop yard.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~240 trailers counted across the east-side drop yard and dock faces in z18 imagery - approximate.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Overhead count estimate; portions of dock faces obscured by backed-in trailers - moderate confidence.
